messages.author: Lennart Gundelach
messages.body:
Hi,
I am trying to run an MMPBSA calc in MMPBSA.py with the option use_sav=0. However the keyword in not recognized neither when used in the basin MMPBSA.py input file nor when using a manually modified  _MMPBSA_pb.mdin file and the -use-mdins option.
Is this keyword not supported in the python implementation of the pbsa module?
Thanks,
Lennart
